name: link-card
title: Link card
description: A card that is one link: icon or image, title, description and an arrow, with a focus ring around the whole card.
docs: The title is the only link, stretched over the card. With asChild, pass your framework link as the child (a Next Link with no text and its own href); the title is added inside it. external adds an arrow and a hidden opens in a new tab.
